source: Tech stack & documentation board (sections 6, 7, 12), changed by the owner's review answers on 2026-11-14. Each block says where its values come from: 'board' = printed on the board; 'owner' = decided by the owner in review; 'proposed' = chosen by Claude at the owner's request ('you implement it, best option') and still to be reviewed.

level.origin: board, minus the quick check (owner: 'we don't care about the knowledge test'); bands redrawn (proposed)
level.bands_note: The board's bands (0-2 / 3-5 / 6-7) assumed 7 points. With 5 points, Expert still needs nearly everything: 5+ years alone gives 2 (Intermediate), as the board intended ('years alone are not enough').

risk.origin: board; échéance mapping confirmed by the owner

caps.answer_shown_fr: vous avez répondu « réduire ma position » à la question sur une baisse de 20 %

risk.caps_apply_to_overrides: a risk chosen by hand on the Profile tab above a cap's max_risk is refused, with the answer that limits it named (owner review, 2026-11-14)

filters.origin: board, except 'asset_class_rules' (proposed, from the owner's direction: market cap matters; blue-chip ETFs for novices)
filters.markets: only the markets picked (US / Canada / global = both)

volatility.measure: standard deviation of daily returns over 1 year, annualized with sqrt(252)

market_cap_floor_usd.currency_note: Canadian market caps are converted to USD with the Bank of Canada FXUSDCAD rate of the snapshot day before comparing

liquidity.measure: average traded value per day (10-day average volume x last price)

esg.filter_only: ESG is a filter, not a preference: no universe entry carries it as a theme, so it selects no candidate, does not count as a picked theme in the 'no preference' test (ESG alone means every stock and ETF in the picked markets, then only 'screened' passes), and adds no profile-fit points
esg.data: mock, set by hand per asset; labelled 'demo data' in the UI

etf.market_cap_floor: not applied: a fund has assets, not a company market cap
etf.blue_chip: an ETF on the hand-kept list data/blue-chip-etfs.json: tracks a broad index (S&P 500, total US market, S&P/TSX 60, S&P/TSX Composite, all-in-one), each entry with the issuer's page as its source

novice.stocks: market cap >= US$10B, whatever the risk band

bond_yields.shown_as: reference card, not ranked (a yield is not a price)

score.origin: weights and factor meanings: board. Formulas: proposed.
score.changed: score-v1.1 (2026-11-14): diversification formula. Under score-v1 a stock adding a new sector scored 0 once any stock was held (its asset class was held), while a stock in an already held sector could score 50: the opposite of the factor's meaning. It now looks at the sector, or at the asset class only for an asset with no sector. Decisions logged before keep 'score-v1'.
score.total: sum(weight x factor) / 100, rounded to 1 decimal

profile_fit.meaning: sector, niche, theme and brand match
profile_fit.formula: sum of the parts that apply, capped at 100
profile_fit.theme_match_note: the ESG theme never counts as a theme match (see filters.esg.filter_only)

risk_fit.meaning: how close volatility sits to the band
risk_fit.formula: 100 if volatility is inside the user's band interval; if below the interval's lower bound L: 100 - 50 x (L - volatility) / L; above the upper bound never happens (filtered out)

fundamentals.formula: mean of the parts that have data; 50 and flagged 'no data' if none (ETFs, crypto)

parts.pe_vs_sector: r = company P/E (Finnhub peTTM) / median P/E of the candidates in the same sector in this snapshot; score = 100 if r <= 0.5, 0 if r >= 2.0, linear in between; no score if P/E is missing or negative
parts.growth: g = revenue growth, trailing twelve months, year over year (Finnhub revenueGrowthTTMYoy, in %); score = 0 if g <= -10, 100 if g >= 20, linear in between

diversification.meaning: adds a sector or class not yet held
diversification.formula: For an asset with a sector: 100 if that sector is not in the simulated holdings; 50 if the sector is held but is under 20% of the portfolio value; 0 otherwise. For an asset with no sector (ETF, crypto): the same three steps with its asset class in place of the sector. An empty portfolio gives 100 to everything, so the factor does not change the order then.

selection.max_etfs_per_index_note: proposed: several listed funds track the same index (four track the S&P 500); one per index keeps the list from repeating the same holdings
selection.seed_tickers: kept if they pass the filters: a seed (a brand on the brands list) that passes every filter takes a slot before anything else and is not subject to the score cut-off, max_per_sector, max_etfs_per_index or the newcomer margin; max_crypto and the top_n of the level still apply
selection.caps_exception: max_per_sector and max_etfs_per_index apply only to the picks filled by score. Seeds, and listed picks still inside their min_days_listed stay, are placed first and are not subject to these two caps, so a sector or an index can hold more than the cap when those picks alone exceed it; they still count toward the cap for every pick filled after them. max_crypto and top_n_by_level apply to every pick.

slow_moving.min_days_listed_exception: removed earlier if it fails a filter

representation.Expert: every factor, raw values, sources, versions, sortable

reasons.if_none_applies: the card shows facts only (sector, % move)
reasons.text_fr_note: French wording of each template (Québec usage), same placeholders. In French an index is shown without a trailing 'Index' ("l’indice S&P 500"), a sector by its French GICS name, and {window} as '1 mois'.
reasons.never_words_fr_matching: whole word, any case, accents significant ('sûr' is listed, 'sur' is not); plural and feminine forms (+e, +es, +s) count. Both lists are checked on every sentence, English or French.

data_freshness.news_use: shown on the card, never scored

strategy.note: Read by the one rules evaluator shared by the live app and the replay (lib/strategy/evaluate.ts). The priority, the anti-oscillation delay and the minimum order size were agreed on 2026-11-15. price_threshold is the V1 rule kind: it comes last and keeps its V1 delay (at most one firing per market day).

agent.origin: board; models and region changed by the owner
whitelisted_actions: look up a quote or company
agent.whitelisted_actions_note: the last two change stored state, so the router runs them only after the user confirms the proposed action in the app

models.note: Board said Claude + Amazon Nova; the owner chose Sonnet 5.5 and Haiku. Both answered a test call on 2026-11-15 UTC. Use the 'us.' profiles: the 'global.' profile routed a test call to ap-northeast-1.

agent.bedrock_region_note: Board says Montréal; the workshop account denies Bedrock in ca-central-1. Changed by the owner on 2026-11-14.

unspecified: Data sources for Canadian quotes, history and sector: see docs/spec.md section 5 for the options and their terms. Awaiting the owner's choice.
Sector list, niches per sector and theme membership: depend on the universe source chosen.
The blue-chip ETF list itself (data/blue-chip-etfs.json) is to be written and reviewed.
Profile-conflict check: uses the profile's own filter values; no extra threshold defined.
